bugs.title: Web server version exposed in HTTP response headers
steps: Send any HTTP request to dev.nerja.ai
Inspect response headers in DevTools → Network tab
bugs.observed: Server: nginx/1.24.0 (Ubuntu) — exact version and OS exposed in every response
bugs.expected: Server header absent or generic (e.g., 'Server: nginx' with no version)
bugs.impact: Attackers can identify exact server version and OS to target known CVEs for nginx 1.24.0 on Ubuntu. No guesswork required — attack surface is immediately narrowed.
bugs.fix: Add 'server_tokens off;' to nginx.conf in the http or server block, then restart nginx. This removes version info from the Server header and error pages.
bugs.evidence:
HTTP response header: Server: nginx/1.24.0 (Ubuntu)
Present on every response: GET /, GET /login, GET /api/auth/*, etc.

bugs.title: Live chat widget (tawk.to) fails to load — CORS error on all pages
bugs.where: All pages — tawk.to chat widget script
bugs.observed: Access to script at 'https://embed.tawk.to/6a4bf9093681991d478e5672/1jssc9js8' from origin 'https://dev.nerja.ai' has been blocked by CORS policy
bugs.expected: Live chat widget loads and appears in bottom-right corner — available for customer support
bugs.impact: Customer support chat completely unavailable. Users needing real-time help have no way to contact support team via the built-in widget.
bugs.fix: In tawk.to dashboard → Administration → Allowed Domains, add dev.nerja.ai. Also verify the widget ID 6a4bf9093681991d478e5672 matches your tawk.to account property ID.
bugs.evidence:
net::ERR_FAILED https://embed.tawk.to/6a4bf9093681991d478e5672/1jssc9js8
Console error: Access to script ... blocked by CORS policy: No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header present
